parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of wood, providing support and shape to the furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all other parts together, including the doors, shelves, and base, ensuring stability and durability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that provides the main structure for the cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of wood, providing elevation and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents, distributing load evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move but supports the entire cabinet structure.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame, used to cover and access the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior when opened and conceals stored items when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the frame, allowing opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the left door, forming the other half of the cabinet’s front closure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right side of the cabinet’s interior and helps protect contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the frame, allowing opening and closing motion.
